title: 第9章 艾莎夫人第10章 城堡里的女仆
slug: 落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆
lines: ：“那你不要告诉妈妈不就好了~”
蒂芙尼嘟囔道，她在叶海面前说话的时候尾音总是不自觉地会拖一点点软。
就在这时，蒂芙尼像是突然想起了什么，赶忙从椅子上跳了下来：“对了，妈妈早上的时候跟我说，让你有时间去她那里一趟。”
叶海有些无奈：“早上的事情你现在太阳都快落山了才跟我说？”
蒂芙尼双手背在身后，有些不好意思的用右脚脚尖在地上画圈：“我忘记了嘛~”
“行吧，我现在过去。”
叶海有些宠溺的伸手摸了摸蒂芙尼的小脑袋，这孩子骨架极小，肩膀也窄，腰细的一只手就能圈住，但因为从小接受基础骑士礼仪训练，背挺得笔直，站姿像个小孔雀似的。
叶海前不久刚用尺子给她量过，身高一米四九，才到他胸口。
“哎嘿嘿~”
蒂芙尼很是开心的用脑袋蹭了蹭叶海的大手，把她自己的刘海都蹭乱了，她很享受这种两人之间的亲密互动。
就在蒂芙尼和叶海快要走出房间的时候，叶海回头看向站在原地不动的琉璃川千代。
“你难道不知道贴身女仆要一直跟在主人身边服侍吗？”
贴身女仆不贴身，那叫什么贴身女仆呢？
琉璃川千代咬了下唇，迈腿来到了叶海的身后紧跟着，三厘米的小圆头黑皮鞋在地板上踩的噔噔响。
“贴近一点。”
叶海瞥了眼离他得有两米远的琉璃川千代。
琉璃川千代低着头，默默的抬腿又靠近了一些，两人此刻只差一个身位，叶海甚至都能闻到她身上传来的一丝蔷薇花香。
叶海的视线在琉璃川千代裙下的绝对领域停留了片刻，白丝吊带袜的丝质极薄，能隐约透出皮肤。
不错。
叶海满意的点了点头。
看来之前让人专门定制这些衣服的决定没做错。
艾莎夫人的房间离叶海的书房不算远，几人没走几步便已经到了。
“妈妈！”
还没等叶海上去敲门，蒂芙尼就已经蹦蹦跶跶的跑到前面撞门而入。
原本正站在窗边眺望枫叶城城市风景的艾莎夫人转过身，有些无奈的柔声道：“蒂芙尼，我教过你多少次了，进门之前要先敲门。”
“淑女可不能这样莽撞用双手把门啪的一声直接推到墙上。”
艾莎夫人穿着一条酒红色的天鹅绒长裙，显得很是成熟优雅，还透露着一股知性的美感。
蒂芙尼小嘴微微撅起：“可是我不想当淑女，我想成为一名骑士，就跟圣女贞德一样的那种女骑士。”
“而且我已经在参加骑士训练了，所以妈妈你不能用淑女的标准来要求我。”
说着，蒂芙尼还像守在城堡大门外的骑士一样挺直了腰杆，只是她那不到一米五的身高实在是没有什么威慑力。
艾莎夫人有些无奈：“我亲爱的伯爵大人，我就说不该让这孩子去折腾什么骑士训练吧，你看看现在都成什么样了。”
“完全没有一丁点淑女的风范。”
叶海走到窗边的沙发上坐下，嘴角露出了一丝笑意：“我倒是觉得这样挺好，如果女孩子们一个个都是淑女，那这世界多没意思。”
他的眼神在艾莎夫人身上停留了片刻，艾莎夫人虽然比叶海矮了一个头，但身高女性之中也算是高挑了。
腰肢纤细，或许因为生育过的原因，体型略显丰盈。
content_en:
: "Then just don't tell mom~"
Tiffany muttered that when she spoke in front of Ye Hai, her voice would always drag out a little softly at the end.
At this moment, Tiffany seemed to suddenly remember something and jumped down from the chair: "By the way, mom told me in the morning to let you have time to go to her place."
Ye Hai was a little helpless: "You told me what happened in the morning now that the sun is almost setting?"
Tiffany put her hands behind her back and drew circles on the ground with the tip of her right foot with some embarrassment: "I forgot~"
"Okay, I'll go over now."
Ye Hai reached out and touched Tiffany's little head dotingly. The child had a very small frame, narrow shoulders, and a thin waist that could be hugged by one hand. However, because he had received basic knight etiquette training since childhood, his back was straight and he stood like a peacock.
Ye Hai had just measured her with a ruler not long ago. She was 1.49 meters tall and only reached his chest.
"Hey hey hey~"
Tiffany happily rubbed her head against Ye Hai's big hand, messing up her own bangs. She enjoyed the intimate interaction between the two.
Just when Tiffany and Ye Hai were about to walk out of the room, Ye Hai turned back and looked at Liulicawa Chiyo who was standing still.
"Don't you know that a maid must always be with her master?"
If a personal maid is not personal, then what is a personal maid?
Liulicawa Chiyo bit her lower lip, then moved up to follow Ye Hai, her three-centimeter round-toe black leather shoes making a thumping sound on the floor.
"Get closer."
Ye Hai glanced at Liulicawa Chiyo who was two meters away from him.
Liulichuan Chiyo lowered her head and silently raised her legs to get closer. The two of them were only one body apart at the moment, and Ye Hai could even smell a hint of rose fragrance coming from her body.
Ye Hai's eyes stayed for a moment on the absolute area under Liulichuan Chiyo's skirt. The silk of the white stockings was so thin that it could vaguely show through the skin.
good.
Ye Hai nodded with satisfaction.
It seems that the previous decision to have these clothes specially customized was not a mistake.
Mrs. Aisha's room was not far from Ye Hai's study, and they had already arrived within a few steps.
"Mom!"
Before Ye Hai could knock on the door, Tiffany had already scampered forward and knocked on the door.
Mrs. Elsa, who was standing by the window overlooking the cityscape of Maple Leaf City, turned around and said softly, somewhat helplessly: "Tiffany, how many times have I taught you to knock before entering."
"A lady cannot be so reckless as to slam the door directly into the wall with both hands."
Mrs. Elsa was wearing a burgundy velvet dress. She looked very mature and elegant, and also revealed an intellectual beauty.
Tiffany pursed her lips slightly: "But I don't want to be a lady, I want to be a knight, just like Joan of Arc, the kind of female knight."
"And I'm already participating in knight training, so mom, you can't hold me to the standards of a lady."
As she spoke, Tiffany straightened her back like a knight guarding the castle gate, but her height of less than 1.5 meters was really not a deterrent.
Mrs. Elsa was a little helpless: "My dear Lord Earl, I just said that this child should not be allowed to bother with knight training. Look at what has become now."
"There is absolutely no trace of ladylike character."
Ye Hai walked to the sofa by the window and sat down, with a smile on his lips: "I think this is good. If all the girls were ladies, then this world would be boring."
His eyes lingered on Mrs. Aisha for a moment. Although Mrs. Aisha was a head shorter than Ye Hai, she was considered tall among women.
The waist is slender, and maybe because of childbirth, the body shape is slightly plump.
